name: Salmones Camanchaca S.A.
summary: Salmones Camanchaca S.A. engages in the salmon farming business in Chile. The company offers Atlantic salmon, including whole/HG, steak, servings, and other products; and whole/HG coho, coho steak, and coho portions. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Puerto Montt, Chile. Salmones Camanchaca S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Camanchaca S.A.
